# Mr Selby

> Mr Selby is a teacher-controlled grading co-pilot. Teachers provide assignment
> instructions, a rubric, and student submissions; the workspace drafts rubric-aligned
> scores and inline annotations in the teacher's voice. Teachers review suggestions
> and remain responsible for final grading decisions.

## Principles
- Human review is the default; eligible automated finalization is opt-in.
- Grading is rubric-aware and runs only when a teacher explicitly requests it or enables an eligible workflow.
- Student work is access-restricted and teacher-controlled.
- Low-confidence, off-topic, and integrity-flagged work returns to the teacher review queue.

## Notes for crawlers
- This is a private, authenticated application; most routes require sign-in.
- Mr Selby is not certified compliant with FERPA, GDPR, or similar regulations; institutions should review the actual deployment before use.
- The product is available at https://mrselby.app.
